html:
In the app

Guided mode’s lesson 6 is this chapter: it checks that this lesson’s tags are made, that S4_Registers exists, is called from MainRoutine and verifies, and then watches the line while you run it and ticks each result as it happens:

  • Exist[0] bit 0 is set: LS1 saw the bottle at the head of the line
  • The bit walks with the bottle: Exist[0] bit 3 is set

Chapter 10 is the theory; this is the rung. Add JSR(S4_Registers); to MainRoutine above JSR(S3_Index), and write it in S4_Registers.

Tags this lesson needs

Create these before you type the rungs (Verify reports any you miss as unknown). Tags from earlier lessons are not repeated.

The rungs

How it fits together

At the end of every dwell the registers shift once, the three head registers each taking their head sensor into bit 0, and a fourth, Reject, taking Cam_Bad, the camera’s verdict from step 15. Cam_Bad is 0 until step 15 is written, so the fourth BSL shifts zeros and changes nothing: write it now and the register is in step with the bottles from the first run. The CONTROL tags (Exist_Ctl and the others) belong to the BSLs; 48 is the length, more than the stops on the belt, so a bottle is tracked all the way to the end and off. Make the four registers DINT arrays with Dim 2 and Style Binary.

Run it

Start the line and open Monitor Tags with Exist, Large and Broken expanded. After the first dwell, bit 0 of Exist is 1: a bottle is at the head. At every stop the registers shift and the 1 walks one bit, in step with the bottle on the belt. A large bottle leaves a 1 in Large, a broken one in Broken, and those walk with it too.

Try it

Stop the line, then toggle Conv_Index on and off by hand (Ctrl+T, twice): the dwell runs again, the registers shift, and every bit moves on although no bottle did. That is a register out of step with the world, and why only step 3 may end a dwell. Reset Sim afterwards. Then set Bottle_Feed’s Broken bottles to 50 % for a run and watch the Broken register fill; then back to 15.

rungs.head: S4_Registers · Rung 0
rungs.comment: SHIFT ONCE PER STOP, while the bottles stand still: LS1 (bottle present) into Exist, LS2 (large) into Large, LS3 (broken) into Broken. Watch Exist[0] in Binary style in Controller Tags and see the bits walk down the line one place per stop The fourth register, Reject, takes Cam_Bad: the camera's verdict on the bottle that stood under it during the last stop, so Reject bit n is that verdict n stops on
rungs.words: When Dwell.DN (the done bit of Dwell: Belt stopped: sensors read, feeder drops a bottle) is on, the rung shifts Exist[0] (Bottle present, one bit per stop (LogixPro B3:10). During the dwell: filler 6, capper 9, scrap gate 13, divert gate 20; after the shift (Dwell.DN) one bit higher) one place left, bringing in LS1 (LogixPro I:1/6 · Exist sensor: a bottle at the start of the line), shifts Large[0] (Large bottle (LogixPro B3:20). During the dwell: filler 5, capper 8, scrap gate 12, divert gate 19; after the shift one bit higher) one place left, bringing in LS2 (LogixPro I:1/7 · Size check: beam set so only a large bottle breaks it), shifts Broken[0] (Broken bottle (LogixPro B3:30). During the dwell: filler 4, capper 7, scrap gate 11, divert gate 18; after the shift one bit higher) one place left, bringing in LS3 (LogixPro I:1/8 · Broken check: sees broken bottles only) and shifts Reject[0] (Bad bottle (the camera found no cap, no label or a short fill), one bit per stop from the stop past the camera. During the dwell: scrap gate 0, divert gate 7; after the shift one bit higher) one place left, bringing in Cam_Bad (The verdict for the bottle at the camera, shifted into Reject at the next stop).
rungs.ltr:
1. XIC(Dwell.DN) Examine If Closed asks: true when Dwell.DN is on.
  2. A branch of 4 parallel paths: each path is tested on its own and does its own work.
    Path 1
    1. BSL(Exist[0],Exist_Ctl,LS1,48) Bit Shift Left does: shifts Exist[0] one place left, bringing in LS1. One shift per false-to-true transition of the rung.
    Path 2
    1. BSL(Large[0],Large_Ctl,LS2,48) Bit Shift Left does: shifts Large[0] one place left, bringing in LS2. One shift per false-to-true transition of the rung.
    Path 3
    1. BSL(Broken[0],Broken_Ctl,LS3,48) Bit Shift Left does: shifts Broken[0] one place left, bringing in LS3. One shift per false-to-true transition of the rung.
    Path 4
    1. BSL(Reject[0],Reject_Ctl,Cam_Bad,48) Bit Shift Left does: shifts Reject[0] one place left, bringing in Cam_Bad. One shift per false-to-true transition of the rung.

pats.why: Every bit of the word is a position on the conveyor; one shift per index moves every part’s bit one position along, so a bit at a station says what is standing there.
pats.think: a row of pigeonholes riding along with the conveyor. Put a note in the first hole when a part arrives; every index moves every note one hole along.
pats.watch: The shift has to happen exactly once per index. Drive it from a one-shot or a transition, never from a level that stays true.
